slides.title: Evidence, assessment and repair
slides.body: Read the fixed Zetaris source or explicitly import a handoff. The desk checks its revision and referenced tests and build before it answers.
rows: Exact commit, reported working-tree state and freshness
Matching revision, outcomes and explicit supersession
Missing or stale: refresh. Failed or dirty: fix the source.
slides.disclosure: Refreshing reads observations. CI runs and deployment require separate action.
slides.notes: Sources: server/handoff.ts; server/repair.ts; src/RepairPlan.jsx; docs/validation/repair-ui.md; docs/validation/2026-10-22-repair.json. At most six bounded repair items reference only evidence IDs in the snapshot. Failed/dirty evidence requires genuine source work and new results. Exact supported question: What is the current release decision? The app does not run CI, rewrite old observations or deploy.
